description: This file defines extension methods for configuring TLS security on an Orleans client builder, including methods to load certificates from store or directly from X509Certificate2 objects, and to configure TLS options.

classes.name: OrleansConnectionSecurityHostingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure TLS security for Orleans client builders.

methods.name: UseTls (with storeName, subject, allowInvalid, location, configureOptions)
methods.description: Configures TLS on the client builder by loading a certificate from the specified store with given parameters and applying additional TLS options.

methods.name: UseTls (with X509Certificate2, configureOptions)
methods.description: Configures TLS using a provided X509Certificate2 object and additional options.

methods.name: UseTls (with X509Certificate2)
methods.description: Configures TLS using a provided X509Certificate2 object, ensuring it has a private key.

methods.name: UseTls (with configureOptions)
methods.description: Configures TLS with custom options, validating that a certificate is provided if required.
